column2: Fixed in 676cfb9. Added --proto-redir =https to hermes curl to prevent HTTPS-to-HTTP redirects. Installer is downloaded to tmpdir and executed locally (not curl|bash).

Rejected: upstream Hermes installer does not publish SHA-256 checksums for the install script. We mitigate by downloading to a tmpdir over HTTPS with --proto =https --proto-redir =https before executing, which prevents MITM downgrade attacks. The installer itself is the official distribution method.

Fixed in 676cfb9. Hermes version is now passed to the installer via --version flag when not "latest". The HERMES_HOME profile.d uses a fixed /home/vscode/.hermes fallback (not $HOME) for OpenShift safety.

Rejected: upstream Grok installer does not publish SHA-256 checksums for the install script. We mitigate with --proto =https --proto-redir =https and download-then-execute pattern. This is the official distribution method from x.ai.
Fixed in 7c53980. CAO now installs uv with UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local so tools are system-wide accessible. The VERSION option pins to a specific git ref; "latest" uses main branch.
Fixed in 7c53980. uv is installed with UV_INSTALL_DIR=/usr/local, so uv tools install to /usr/local/bin directly — accessible to all users including non-root.
Fixed in 676cfb9. Hermes version is now passed to the installer via --version flag when VERSION is not "latest".
Fixed in 7c53980. Removed the orphaned apiKey option from claude/devcontainer-feature.json. API keys are no longer persisted — users set them at runtime via env vars or secrets.
Fixed in 7c53980. Goose checksum download now fails the build if checksums.txt is unavailable or doesn't contain the expected tarball entry. No more || true on checksum verification.

Rejected: README files are auto-generated by the release workflow (per AGENTS.md convention) and must not be hand-edited. The symlink change is in install.sh; the README will be regenerated on release.

Rejected: README files are auto-generated by the release workflow. The version tag in the README will be updated when the 2.0.0 release is published. Hand-editing READMEs is explicitly prohibited by repo convention.
